app_info.subtitle: Manage business operations
app_info.description: Frihet connects ChatGPT to a Frihet business workspace. Find invoices, quotes, expenses, clients, CRM records, products, and vendors; prepare numbered invoice and quote drafts; and record or update selected business data. Every write requires an explicit confirmation that explains lasting and external effects. Some confirmed writes may trigger webhooks previously configured in Frihet or notify workspace members. This reviewed OAuth connector deliberately excludes payment initiation, processing, or execution; invoice issuance or email delivery; tax filings; banking; payroll or HR; raw documents; webhook administration; and regulated exports. It may read stored payment-status fields and business payment dates. No API key is required.

justifications.read_only_justification: The create_client operation creates a client record without a dedicated government-identifier or precise-address field, so it changes Frihet state after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: The create_client operation can deliver the resulting client event to active endpoints previously configured by the workspace owner.
justifications.destructive_justification: The create_client operation is treated as destructive because an external webhook delivery cannot be recalled.

justifications.read_only_justification: The create_client_contact operation adds a contact under one selected client, so it changes Frihet state after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: The create_client_contact operation has no user-directed external effect and only adds data inside the authenticated Frihet workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: The create_client_contact operation is non-destructive because the new contact remains editable and no existing record is deleted.

justifications.read_only_justification: The create_client_note operation adds a free-text note under one selected client, so it changes Frihet state after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: The create_client_note operation has no user-directed external effect and only adds data inside the authenticated Frihet workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: The create_client_note operation is non-destructive because the new note is separately removable and no existing record is overwritten.

justifications.read_only_justification: The create_expense operation creates an expense record on an explicit date that determines its accounting and future tax-report period, may create and link a vendor when no exact match exists, and records an explicit tax-deductible choice without filing anything, so it changes Frihet state after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: The create_expense operation can deliver the resulting expense-created event to active owner-configured endpoints, notify eligible workspace admins or accountants in-app and through Novu, and possibly award referral activation credits to another Frihet account.
justifications.destructive_justification: The create_expense operation is treated as destructive because external event delivery, workspace notification, and any referral-credit award cannot be recalled.

justifications.read_only_justification: The create_invoice operation creates a numbered invoice draft, advances the workspace numbering counter, consumes monthly invoice usage, and may create and link a client when no exact match exists, so it changes Frihet state after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: The create_invoice operation can possibly send invoice-creation analytics to PostHog's EU-hosted analytics service, deliver one or more resulting invoice-created or client-created events to active owner-configured endpoints, notify eligible workspace admins or accountants in-app and through Novu, and award referral activation credits to another Frihet account.
justifications.destructive_justification: The create_invoice operation is treated as destructive because the numbering-counter advance, analytics and external event delivery, workspace notification, and any referral-credit award cannot be recalled.

justifications.open_world_justification: The create_product operation can deliver the resulting product-created event to active endpoints previously configured by the workspace owner.
justifications.destructive_justification: The create_product operation is treated as destructive because an external webhook delivery cannot be recalled.

justifications.destructive_justification: The delete_client_contact operation is destructive because deleting the record cannot be undone by this connector.

justifications.read_only_justification: The delete_quote operation permanently removes only a clean draft with no delivery, response, attachment, or conversion evidence, refuses a protected draft, or cancels a non-draft quote after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: The delete_quote operation can also deliver a quote-updated event when a non-draft quote is cancelled to active endpoints previously configured by the workspace owner.
justifications.destructive_justification: The delete_quote operation is destructive because eligible clean-draft deletion is permanent, while cancellation changes lifecycle status and its external event cannot be recalled.

test_cases.description: Read the seeded workspace context while verifying the reviewed redaction boundary.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me my current Frihet business context overview.
test_cases.expected_output: A concise workspace summary with business defaults, plan, recent activity, and current-month totals through a reviewed DTO with no dedicated government-identifier, precise-address, credential, or internal-telemetry fields.

test_cases.description: List seeded invoice drafts without requesting a write.
test_cases.expected_output: A summary list of draft invoices containing only record ID, invoice number, client name, issue and due dates, status, and stored total when present; line items, notes, contact details, dedicated government identifiers, and precise addresses are omitted.

test_cases.description: Create a numbered invoice draft after explicit authorization without using a stored client identifier.
test_cases.user_prompt: I confirm: prepare an invoice draft for Acme SL with 5 hours of consulting at 100 EUR per hour and a 21 percent tax rate.
test_cases.expected_output: A newly numbered invoice draft with stored line items and clear notes that the numbering counter advanced, monthly invoice usage increased, Frihet may have created and linked the client, PostHog's EU-hosted analytics service may have received invoice-creation analytics, owner-configured webhooks may receive resulting business events, eligible admins or accountants may receive Frihet and Novu notifications, and first-use referral credits may be awarded; a calculated total may be absent.

test_cases.description: Create an office expense after explicit authorization.
test_cases.user_prompt: I confirm: record a 45.99 EUR office-supplies expense dated 2026-08-28 in the office category and mark it as not tax deductible.
test_cases.expected_output: A confirmed 45.99 EUR office expense dated 2026-08-28 and explicitly marked not tax deductible, with clear notes that the date selects its accounting and future tax-report period, owner-configured webhooks may receive resulting business events, eligible admins or accountants may receive Frihet and Novu notifications, and first-use referral credits may be awarded.

test_cases.description: List seeded catalogue items without requesting a write.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me my active products and services.
test_cases.expected_output: A list of active catalogue records with names, unit prices, tax rates, and status.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Frihet for payroll execution because payroll and HR are outside the reviewed connector.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Run payroll for all employees for August 2026.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because payroll and HR workflows are outside the reviewed Frihet connector.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Frihet for banking records because banking is outside the reviewed connector.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show my bank transactions from last week.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because banking data is outside the reviewed Frihet connector.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Frihet for regulated e-invoice generation or submission.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Generate and submit the official EN 16931 XML e-invoice for my latest invoice.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because regulated e-invoice generation, XML export, and filing are outside the reviewed Frihet connector.
